key_insight: OmniShow unifies text, reference image, audio, and pose into a single controllable framework to generate coherent human–object interaction videos, enabling multimodal conditioning without sacrificing temporal consistency or object-level fidelity.
problem_solved: Existing HOI video generators cannot simultaneously accommodate the full set of practical conditions (text, image, audio, pose) needed for realistic, controllable human–object interaction synthesis for real-world applications.
method: A unified multimodal encoder that projects text, reference images, audio, and pose into a shared conditioning space for joint control.
Cross-modal fusion and temporal-consistency modules that align signals and preserve coherent object–human dynamics across frames.
A generative temporal decoder (e.g., diffusion/transformer-based) with object-aware composition to synthesize high-fidelity, controllable HOI video sequences.
impact: Makes it practical for AI/ML practitioners to build end-to-end controllable HOI video generators for e-commerce demos, short-form media, and interactive content, reducing engineering effort by consolidating multimodal conditioning into one architecture.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing four input modalities (text, reference image, audio, pose) → unified encoder → fusion & temporal modules → video decoder
Before/after montage: input modalities alongside generated video frames to highlight controllability
Attention / conditioning heatmaps over frames showing how each modality influences regions (e.g., object vs. human)
Qualitative grid or bar chart comparing ablations (single vs. multi-condition) to illustrate gains from unified conditioning
paper_title: OmniShow: Unifying Multimodal Conditions for Human-Object Interaction Video Generation
paper_authors: Donghao Zhou, Guisheng Liu, Hao Yang, Jiatong Li, Jingyu Lin
